about_the_game:
DEMO: play the first set of levels of The Last Mullu for free!

You're the last of your people. The last Mullu alive. You're backed up against the mountains and you need to fight for survival against the evil invaders. Use your companions for help, build towers, and duel hand-to-hand. Do anything you can to persevere.

Build and upgrade distinct towers to protect your base against waves of unpredictable enemies. Engage in melee combat with blocking and dodging mechanics to hold off foes in close quarters. Choose a companion animal with unique abilities to aid in battle - all set against a mountainous and coastal pixel art backdrop. Every playthrough will be distinct with randomized enemies and rougelike components. The numerous towers and companions allow you to test and develop different strategies every time they pick up the game.

About the developer:

My name is Bob - I am the sole developer here at Cylindrical Duck Games. I made The Last Mullu from scratch, including the pixel art (which took forever), and I hope whoever plays this enjoys it as much as I did making it. If you have any questions, concerns, or just want to talk gaming, feel free to hit me up.

Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7
  • Processor: A dual-core processor from the last decade should be sufficient
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3+ or Vulkan 1.0

short_description: The Last Mullu combines the strategy of tower building with the replayability and intensity of roguelikes. Pick a companion and fight for survival in this mountainous and coastal 2D pixel art world.
